fields.label: First Reminder (Days Before Expiry)
fields.description: Fleet Mgmt.docx quotes 14 days in section 3 and the 4.6 heading, 30 days in the 4.6 trigger detail, and 30/15/7 in section 5. Confirm with GDL and set the agreed value here.

fields.label: Third Reminder (Days)
fields.description: Set to 0 to switch this reminder off.

fields.label: Final Reminder (Days)
fields.description: Set to 0 to switch this reminder off.

fields.label: Driving Licence Expiry Notice (Days)
fields.description: How far ahead to warn that a driver's licence expires. Separate from the renewal ladder above: a licence takes longer to replace than a policy. 0 switches it off.

fields.label: Abnormal Daily KM Threshold
fields.description: Section 4.3 requires a warning on abnormal daily mileage.

fields.label: Maintenance Rules
fields.description: Service intervals by distance and/or time. Add or change rules here - they are never hard-coded.

fields.label: Default Maintenance Team
fields.description: Used when a vehicle's maintenance plan is created.

fields.label: Performance Display Precision (KM/L)
fields.description: Decimal places used when DISPLAYING performance per litre. The accurate value is always stored in full.

fields.label: Enforce Unique Supply Memo No.
fields.description: Rejects a supply memo number already used on another POL Abstract for the same vehicle.

fields.label: Carry Forward Opening KM
fields.description: Suggests Opening KM from the previous abstract's Closing KM. Always overridable.

fields.label: Carry Forward Tank Balance
fields.description: Suggests Previous Tank Balance from the previous abstract's Present Tank Balance. Always overridable.

fields.label: Carry Forward Fuel Book Balance
fields.description: Unspent coupon on a vehicle's previous abstract becomes the opening balance on the next one.

fields.label: Mileage Deviation Tolerance (%)
fields.description: Actual km/l may differ from the vehicle's minimum by this much in EITHER direction before HR approval is required.

fields.label: Movement Order Approval
fields.description: Simple: the user applies and the location MTO approves. Full: the original Validate -> Review -> MTO/CEO -> FAS chain. Changing this takes effect on the next migrate.

fields.label: Only the Location MTO May Approve
fields.description: A request is approved by the MTO listed for its location, or by the head office MTO. Switch off to let any user holding the approver role approve.

fields.label: Location Managers (MTO)
fields.description: One row per location: who requests, and who approves. Tick Head Office for the final MTO.

fields.label: Minimum Booking Lead Time (Hours)
fields.description: Requests raised inside this window need a short-notice reason.

fields.label: BOD Supplier
fields.description: Supplier the BOD fuel claim is invoiced to.

fields.label: STCBL Supplier
fields.description: Supplier the STCBL fuel claim is invoiced to.

fields.label: Fuel Expense Account (Fallback)
fields.description: Used only for a company with no row in the table above. It must belong to that company and must not be a group account.

fields.label: Raise Fuel Invoice Automatically on Approval
fields.description: Leave off to create the invoice by hand from the approved abstract.

fields.label: Purchasing Company
fields.description: Company the fleet purchase orders are raised under.

fields.label: Notify Role
fields.description: Who is told when a purchase order is raised, or cannot be.

fields.label: Raise Purchasing Document on Bill Approval
fields.description: Off by default. When on, approving a driver's service bill creates the document chosen below. External maintenance is already done when the bill arrives, so nothing is raised on mere completion.

fields.label: Maintenance Service Item
fields.description: The Item a workshop service is purchased as. Vehicle Service Item is a maintenance category, not an Item, so it cannot be used on a purchase order.

fields.label: Raise Purchase Order When Insurance Expires
fields.description: Off by default. Turns on the daily check for expired insurance.

fields.label: Insurance Renewal Item
fields.description: The Item an insurance renewal is purchased as.

fields.label: Default Insurance Supplier
fields.description: Used when the renewal record names no supplier of its own.

fields.label: Raise Renewal PO This Many Days Before Expiry
fields.description: 0 raises it on the day the policy expires. A positive number raises it in advance, which is usually what a broker needs.

fields.options:
Purchase Invoice
Purchase Order then Invoice
fields.label: Document to Raise
fields.description: The work is finished and the bill is in hand, so a Purchase Invoice normally matches reality. Choose the other option only if company policy demands a Purchase Order even after the fact.

fields.label: Require the Bill Attachment
fields.description: A driver cannot submit a bill without a scan of the service centre's invoice.

fields.label: Bill Approver Role
fields.description: Who may approve a service bill. Falls back to the Notify Role.

fields.label: Require the Supplier Bill Attachment
fields.description: A POL Abstract cannot be submitted for approval without a scan of the supplier's fuel bill or supply memos.

fields.label: Fuel Expense Account by Company
fields.description: Vehicles in different companies post to different accounts. Give each company the account its fuel is charged to. The single account below is used only for a company that has no row here.
